clause.quote: A Stream parser MUST be able to use the Version String to extract and deserialize (deterministically) any serialized Stream field maps.

description: A JSON field map with a 2.XX version string, with the last five bytes of the stream removed, so the body is shorter than the size its version string declares. The specification has no sentence saying such a stream must be rejected; the assertion rests on the cited MUST, which this stream violates, so it cannot be decoded as a conforming stream. Any rejection satisfies the assertion; the class in the note is informative.
title: Reject a JSON body shorter than its version string declares
